planScope: D0.0/D0.3 evidence before D4.1 retry and projection changes

observedProblem.note: Request and stderr entries are different observations of attempts; do not sum them or interpret them as unique business failures.

changes: Add allowlisted reason, phase and projection scope fields to existing failure logs.
Distinguish busy, expired or replaced leases and changed progress authority; leave unrecognized dependency errors unclassified.
Keep classifications in a WeakMap so callable error envelopes and stored queue documents remain unchanged.
Preserve unavailable errors, Eventarc rejection/retry, shared lease duration, coverage watermarks and stale-writer fencing.

production.followup: Verify the selected serving images and transport, then observe classified failures and backlog in a bounded post-release window before changing retry or capacity. Other Student 360 targets retain their earlier runtime until explicitly deployed.
